description: This file defines filter predicates used for data source pushdown in Spark SQL, including various filter classes like EqualTo, GreaterThan, In, and logical combinations, as well as collation-aware variants.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Abstract base class for all filter predicates used in Spark SQL data source pushdown.

classes.name: EqualTo
classes.description: Filter for attribute equal to a specific value.

classes.name: EqualNullSafe
classes.description: Filter for attribute equal to a value with null-safe comparison.

classes.name: GreaterThan
classes.description: Filter for attribute greater than a value.

classes.name: GreaterThanOrEqual
classes.description: Filter for attribute greater than or equal to a value.

classes.name: LessThan
classes.description: Filter for attribute less than a value.

classes.name: LessThanOrEqual
classes.description: Filter for attribute less than or equal to a value.

classes.name: In
classes.description: Filter for attribute within a set of values.

classes.name: StringStartsWith
classes.description: Filter for string attribute starting with a value.

classes.name: StringEndsWith
classes.description: Filter for string attribute ending with a value.

classes.name: StringContains
classes.description: Filter for string attribute containing a value.

classes.name: AlwaysTrue
classes.description: Filter that always evaluates to true.

classes.name: AlwaysFalse
classes.description: Filter that always evaluates to false.

methods.name: toV2
methods.description: Converts the filter to a V2 predicate.

methods.name: toV2Column
methods.description: Converts attribute name to a NamedReference, handling quoting and parsing.
